source.note: Every value is taken from the stylesheet. Tonal ramps are omitted on purpose: the build defines none and synthesised steps would not be values the build uses.

ink.use: Primary text and numerals; the fill of everything in inverse video (solid tags, keycaps, selected tab, focus ring, selection, cursor).

caution.use: A zone from the action level up to danger. Safety state only.

danger.use: A zone at the danger level. Safety state only.

critical.use: A zone at the critical level. Safety state only.

ok.use: Lamps only: an 8px square meaning below the action level. Never text or a larger fill.

measure.use: Measurement drawn on the video (gate lines, gate blocks, floor grid) and the gate name on the board.

ground.use: Screen, tiles, sheets; text on any ink or level-colour fill.

lift.use: Background of the selected zone row.

strip.use: Title strips, the key bar, sheet footers.

rule.use: Hairlines between tiles, rows, cells and table lines.

rule-strong.use: Hollow outlines, ruler base and minor ticks, chart axes, sheet border, disabled tabs and keycaps.

label.use: Secondary text: strips, units, detail lines, axis labels, timestamps, off toggles.

faint.use: Status-line field labels, step numbers, unlit level-mark bars, unselected trace lines, disabled key words.

numeral-lead.purpose: Density figure of a zone at danger or critical; the selected zone's figure only while no zone is that serious.

wordmark.purpose: CROWDPULSE in the status line, capitals.

headline.purpose: The headline of a response plan.

prose.purpose: Plan steps, PA text, sheet paragraphs and tables. Line-height 1.5 in sheets, max 68ch.

label.purpose: Strips, keys, tabs, state words, field labels, table headers, in capitals. Without capitals or tracking: units, detail lines, axis labels, timestamps.

code.purpose: Tags, keycaps, the command line, step numbers.

outlines.name: inset-hairline
outlines.purpose: Outline of hollow tags, off keycaps and video blocks. Drawn with box-shadow so it adds no size; the only use of box-shadow.

motion.name: step-blink
motion.purpose: Lamp of a zone at danger or critical.

motion.name: annunciate
motion.purpose: Unacknowledged alert band flips between colour-on-black and black-on-colour.

motion.name: cursor
motion.purpose: Typing cursor after a line that is still being written.

motion.name: pointer-step
motion.purpose: Ruler pointer moving to a new reading.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes every animation and transition.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Tiles stack into one scrolling column; status line, annunciator and key bar wrap; video blocks collapse to their code.

components.name: Strip

components.html: Zoneslocal peak density, people/m²LIVE

components.name: Tag
components.description: Short code. Solid for the selected thing, hollow otherwise, level colour in an alerting zone row.

components.description: Every control: a keycap showing the real shortcut, plus a word. Toggle-off and disabled variants shown.

narrative.overview:
CrowdPulse is a terminal, not a dashboard. One true-black screen of gapless tiles divided by 1px hairlines, read like a market board by an operator who sits in front of it for a whole event. There is no radius, no cast shadow, no gradient and no card: a tile is a rectangle of ground with a grey title strip, and the camera is one instrument among the others.

Hierarchy comes from scale and from inverse video, never from colour. Ink is a warm white; labels are grey. Colour is held back for the safety levels, so that when a zone crosses the action level the amber, orange or red on screen is the only colour there is. Cyan is the one other hue, and it belongs to measurement drawn on the video. Every control is a keycap plus a word, because the console is driven from the keyboard.

State changes step. Lamps blink in two hard frames, the annunciator band flips between colour-on-black and black-on-colour, and the ruler pointer jumps in steps. Nothing fades, eases or slides.
keyCharacteristics: True black ground, gapless tiles, 1px hairlines.
Zero radius, no cast shadows, no gradients.
Colour means a safety level; cyan means a measurement on the video.
Selection and emphasis are inverse video.
Controls are keycaps; every action has a key and a command word.
Codes and states in capitals, prose in sentence case.

rules.name: The Reserved Colour Rule
rules.body: Hue is a safety state. Amber, orange and red appear only when a zone is at caution, danger or critical; green appears only as a lamp. No hue is used for branding, decoration, categories or emphasis.

rules.name: The Measurement Cyan Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks something measured and drawn on the video, and the board's reference to it. It is never a link, a selection or an accent.

rules.name: The Inverse Video Rule
rules.body: Selected, pressed-on and primary are shown by swapping ink and ground, not by adding a colour.

rules.name: The Not Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every level also has a word (NORMAL, CAUTION, DANGER, CRITICAL), a position on the ruler and a numeral size. The legend shows non-alerting levels as hollow squares.

rules.name: The Scale Is Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: The largest thing on the board is the most serious zone's figure. Size is earned by severity or selection, not by position.

rules.name: The Capitals Rule
rules.body: Codes, names, states and key words are capitals; anything a person reads as a sentence is sentence case. A strip's explanatory phrase ("last 60 s, people/m²") is sentence case with no tracking.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Things are separated by a 1px line or by nothing. Structural lines between tiles and rows are real borders or the 1px grid gap; outlines around a small object (hollow tag, off keycap, video block, hollow legend square) are drawn with `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px` so they add no size. That inset line is the only use of `box-shadow`.

dos: Do build new surfaces from tiles: ground background, a 24px strip, 1px hairlines, no gap wider than 1px between panels.
Do give every action a keycap and a command word, and show the key on the control.
Do show selection with inverse video (ink background, black text) or the lift background.
Do set anything at caution or above by putting `data-level` on its container and reading `--lv` and `--lamp`.
Do put black text on any level-colour or ink fill.
Do use tabular figures for every live number and give each one its unit.
Do step state changes with `steps()`; two frames for blinks.
Do draw small outlines with the 1px inset line so the object keeps its size.
donts: Don't round a corner. Lamps and swatches are squares.
Don't add a cast shadow, blur, glass effect or gradient.
Don't use amber, orange, red or green for anything but a safety level, or cyan for anything but a measurement on the video.
Don't add a brand or accent colour; ink in inverse video is the accent.
Don't separate panels with space or wrap content in cards.
Don't fade, ease or slide anything.
Don't set a figure larger than 22px unless its zone is selected or at danger or critical.
Don't load a font or any asset from the network.
